prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1228; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the claimant in connection with the rear-end collision that occurred involving your insured. Our client was injured in the incident and has retained us to pursue the resulting claim. Please direct all further communications regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. If your insured has been represented by counsel or has a personal representative, please forward this notice to them as well.

To allow us to evaluate the claim properly, we request a written statement of the bodily injury liability limits under the policy covering your insured, along with confirmation of any other coverage that may apply. Please also provide the name of the adjuster assigned to this file.

We further ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to the collision. This includes the claim file, photographs, vehicle data and event recorder information, repair and total loss records, witness statements, recorded calls, and any dash camera or surveillance footage. Please suspend any routine deletion or disposal of these materials until the matter is resolved.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
